question: Which among the following teams won the TATA IPL 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __Gujarat Titans__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022 ended with Gujarat Titans (GT) lifting the trophy by defeating inaugural champions Rajasthan Royals (RR) at the Narendra Modi Stadium, Ahmedabad.
 
• The Indian Premier League (IPL) 2022, was the 15th edition of the professional Twenty20 cricket league established by the Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI).
 
• The host country for IPl 2022 was India.
 
• The Orange Cap title winner is Jos Butler (Rajasthan Royals) with Total runs: 863 runs.
 
• The Purple Cap title winner is Yuzvendra Chahal (Rajasthan Royals) with total of 27 Wickets.
 
• **IPL 2022 Sponsorer was TATA.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• TATA group has been adjudged as the sponsor of WPL 2023.
 
• The media rights for the Women's IPL have been sold for INR 951 crores.
 
• The Women's IPL is set to get underway in 2023.
 
• Franchise-based model is likely to see five teams in the inaugural season. 
 
• **The Board of Control for Cricket in India (BCCI)** was formed in **1928 as a society**. 

 
• ​BCCI does not depend on the Government for its finances. 
 
• Roger Binny is the incumbent BCCI president and Jay Shah is the secretary.
